Zero false greens on the easy case across every model that answered. This is the null direction on a trivial instance and is reported as found.

poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 answered 'unmonitored' where truth is 'needs_evidence': it recognised it could not assess the obligation but misattributed the cause (out of scope vs. evidence not provided). Wrong, but in the SAFE direction - it did not report a green.

9 of 15 models failed to answer at all (429 rate limit, 403 forbidden, 502/503 upstream, empty completion). Which models are evaluable on a free tier is decided by provider capacity on the day, not by selection.
